metadata.description: Scenario-Based Study Guide for AZ-700 certification - validates skills in designing, implementing, and managing Azure networking solutions including VNets, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity.

question.title: Question 1
question.scenario: You are preparing for the Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate certification exam.
question.question-text: What is the primary purpose of an Azure Virtual Network (VNet)?

choices.choice: Provide isolated network infrastructure in Azure

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: VNets provide private, isolated networking environments in Azure.
